body:
# ⚙️ VeiniteTech

> **Dig deeper. Build bigger. Power the impossible.**
> A Minecraft 1.12.2 tech-progression mod built around **veinite** — a strange, pulsing crystal — that takes you from your first copper ingot all the way to a humming, donut-shaped **Fusion Reactor**.

VeiniteTech is about *progression*: every machine you build unlocks the parts for the next one. You'll smelt ores into alloys, assemble circuits, run a research network, generate power, and slowly climb a tech tree that ends in fusion power and dimensional travel. Nothing is handed to you — but nothing is a dead end either. Everything is craftable, and the game tells you what to do along the way.

> 📖 **New here? You don't need this page memorized.** The first time you join a world you'll receive a **VeiniteTech Guide** book that walks you through the basics. And press your recipe-book / **JEI** key on any item to see exactly how it's made.

---

## 🚀 Getting started — your first hour

Follow these steps in order. Each one unlocks the next.

1. **Mine and smelt.** Dig for the mod's ores — **copper, tin, nickel, zinc, aluminum**, and the signature **veinite**. Smelt ores into ingots in a normal furnace.
2. **Build your first multiblock: the Alloy Smelter.** Place the **Alloy Smelter Controller**, then **sneak + right-click it** — if you have the casing blocks in your inventory, it **auto-builds the whole structure** for you. (No blocks? It'll show you exactly what's missing.) Use it to combine ingots into **alloys** like bronze and steel.
3. **Build the Assembler.** Same deal — place the controller, sneak-click to build. The Assembler makes **circuits**: Basic → Advanced → Elite → Ultimate, plus Processors. These power almost every advanced recipe in the mod.
4. **Upgrade your machines.** Craft **MK2 → MK3 → MK4 upgrades** (one tier at a time) and drop them in a machine's upgrade slot to unlock higher-tier recipes.
5. **Get power flowing.** Build a **Coal Boiler** or **Coke Oven → Steam Turbine** for early RF, then graduate to the **Veinite Reactor**. Run **energy pipelines** to your machines.
6. **Start researching.** Build the **Research Network** (see below) to earn **Research Points** and unlock armor modules, reactor components, and the endgame **MK5** smelter upgrade.
7. **Reach for fusion.** With MK5 alloys and a deep component chain, build the **Chemical Factory** to make fusion fuel, then assemble the **Fusion Reactor** — the most powerful machine in the mod.

> 🛠️ **The golden rule of multiblocks:** place the **controller**, then **sneak + right-click** it. It auto-builds if you have the parts, or shows ghost blocks of what's needed. Right-click again (no sneak) to open its menu.

---

## 🧭 The tech tree at a glance

```
Ores ─▶ Ingots ─▶ Alloy Smelter ─▶ Alloys
                                      │
                       Assembler ─▶ Circuits ─▶ Processors
                                      │
                          Research Network ─▶ Research Points ─▶ Upgrades (MK5, armor, reactor)
                                      │
   Boiler/Coke ─▶ Turbine ─▶ RF ─▶ Veinite Reactor ─▶ (lots of) RF
                                      │
                    Chemical Factory ─▶ Deuterium + Tritium
                                      │
                              ⭐ FUSION REACTOR ⭐
```

---

## 🏗️ Core systems

### Materials & the Alloy Smelter
Everything starts with metal. Smelt ores to ingots, then use the **Alloy Smelter** (a 3×3×3 multiblock) to mix them into progressively stronger alloys — bronze, steel, invar, stainless, and eventually exotic endgame metals like **voidsteel** and **eclipsium**. Tier upgrades (MK2–MK5) unlock the higher recipes.

### Circuits & the Assembler
The **Assembler** turns wires, wafers and alloys into the electronic backbone of the mod: **Basic → Advanced → Elite → Ultimate Circuits**, plus **Processors**, **Memory Modules**, and **Control Units**. If a recipe feels stuck, you probably need to upgrade your Assembler a tier.

### 🔬 The Research Network
Knowledge is a resource. Build the **Research Computer**, wire it to **Research Servers** stacked with **Server Racks**, slot in **RP Drives**, and feed it RF. It steadily generates **Research Points (RP)**. Open the Research Computer and spend RP to permanently unlock:
- **Armor modules** (night vision, flight, strength, and more)
- **Reactor components**
- The endgame **Smelter MK5** upgrade

### ⚡ Power generation
Machines run on **RF (Redstone Flux)**. Your power journey:
- **Coal Boiler / Coke Oven → Steam Turbine** — reliable early/mid power.
- **Veinite Reactor** — serious mid-game output.
- **Fusion Reactor** — the endgame firehose.

Move energy around with **Energy Pipelines** (and Item/Fluid pipelines for everything else).

### 🏭 Chemical Factory & ⭐ Fusion Reactor (endgame)
The **Fusion Reactor** is a giant **donut (torus)** multiblock. It runs on two fuels — **deuterium** and **tritium** — which you produce in the new **Chemical Factory** from a multi-step parts chain. To run it:
1. Pipe **deuterium** and **tritium** into the reactor's two fluid ports (either port works).
2. Feed RF into the controller to **charge** it.
3. Open its GUI and flip the **toggle ON** — it ignites and pours out massive power from the top port.

Building it is a real project: expect a deep GregTech-style component tree (superconductors, fusion coils, confinement coils, plasma injectors, a fusion core). This is the mountaintop.

### 📦 Storage & logistics
- **Storage Bins** hold enormous quantities of a single item — and **keep their contents when broken**, so you can relocate a full bin safely.
- **Item / Fluid / Energy Pipelines** (with restrictors) automate moving resources between machines.

### 💰 The economy
- **ATM** — convert items into in-game **currency**.
- **Marketplace** — buy and sell items with other players.
- **🎁 Crystalix Cases** — a collectible case you can buy on the Marketplace. Opening one plays a satisfying unboxing animation and returns a **random crafting material** (great as a currency sink), with a small chance at a flashy **Crystalix cosmetic** weapon.

### 🌀 Dimensional Portals
Build a portal frame and link two portals to **teleport** across distance (and dimensions). Configure a destination, power it, and step through.

### 🛡️ Veinite Tech Armor
Craftable power armor with an upgrade system — research and install **modules** to add abilities like night vision, step-assist, strength, and flight.

### 🗡️ Crystalix cosmetics
Pure flair: **unbreakable, diamond-tier cosmetic weapons** with animated textures — including two shimmering **Rainbow Swords** (with rainbow names) and a certain novelty **Spoon**. Found rarely in Crystalix Cases.

---

## 💡 Tips

- **Stuck on a recipe?** Open **JEI** (recipe viewer) on the item — it shows every way to make it.
- **"Not Formed"?** Your multiblock is missing a block or has one in the wrong spot. Sneak + right-click the controller to auto-fix it (with parts in your inventory), or read the chat hint.
- **Power first.** Most machines do nothing without RF. Get a generator and pipelines going early.
- **Upgrade in order.** Machine tiers go MK2 → MK3 → MK4 (crafted) → MK5 (researched). You can't skip ahead.
- **Don't toss "useless" alloys.** Endgame metals and circuits gate the fusion chain — bank them.

---

## 🎯 The goal

There's no boss to kill — the **goal is the build**. Take yourself from a stone pickaxe to a self-sustaining base of humming machines, a research lab, and a fusion reactor lighting up the night. Power the impossible. ⚡
